credits.title: Refuse to Yield the Realm
credits.overview: The story of the renowned Ming Dynasty general, Qi Jiguang, who fought against the Wakou pirates. He led the officers and soldiers of the "Qi Family Army" to overcome various obstacles and successfully reclaimed Hengyu Island, which had long been occupied by the Wakou.

credits.title: A Better Jianghu
credits.overview: Two individuals, the scholar Shen Fang and the knight-errant Luo Han, steal a huge sum of silver from the official Qin Hui to support the anti-Jin rebels, devising a grand deception to combat the imperial guard and rally people from all walks of life to their cause during the Southern Song Dynasty.

credits.title: Fight Against Evil 3
credits.overview: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his wedding but must team up with a local cop to rescue a girl from human traffickers, fighting criminals while racing against his wedding date.

credits.overview: Ten years ago a black market fight ended the career of Chinese wrestling champion Zhong Wen and resulted in the accidental death of his wife. His opponent was his estranged brother, but ten years later, they are unexpectedly reunited in the MMA ring.
